education_requirement: Class 8 pass required only if project cost >10L (manufacturing) or >5L (service)
special_conditions: New viable unit only; must not have availed subsidy under PMRY/REGP/PMEGP/CMEGP before
source_notes: Special category applicants get higher subsidy (25% urban/35% rural) vs general (15% urban/25% rural)

ownership_requirement: At least 51% shareholding/control by eligible SC/ST or woman entrepreneur (for partnerships)
special_conditions: Applicant must not be a defaulter with any financial institution
source_notes: Loan range is per enterprise not per individual

scheme_name: National SC/ST Hub - Credit Linked Capital Subsidy
source_notes: Umbrella program with multiple sub-schemes (marketing assistance; performance and credit rating subsidy)

scheme_name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes (CEGSSC)
ministry_body: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
special_conditions: Provides guarantee rather than direct funding
source_notes: Administered alongside Venture Capital Fund scheme for SC entrepreneurs

scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to MSME - SC/ST Component (Gujarat) / Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojna
ministry_body: Industries and Mines Department Government of Gujarat
ownership_requirement: At least 51% contribution by SC/ST entrepreneur
loan_subsidy_amount: Capital subsidy up to 1500000 plus interest subvention
special_conditions: Must apply online within one year of commercial production; subsidy not available if loan sanctioned more than one year after commercial production; state-specific scheme, Gujarat only
status: Active (scheme period 07 Aug 2020 to 06 Aug 2025 - verify current validity)
source_notes: State-level scheme; check if renewed or expired given original end date of Aug 2025

special_conditions: For expansion/modernisation/diversification/technology upgradation of existing or new MSME/Tiny units
source_notes: One source states scheme was withdrawn by SIDBI on 1 Oct 2009; other current sources describe it as active in 2026 - confirm on official SIDBI/myscheme.gov.in listing before including as live

ministry_body: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (under MoSJE)
education_requirement: Varies by loan type; professional degree required for some categories
special_conditions: Age relaxable for professionally qualified entrepreneurs; min age 14 for mental retardation cases; income limit only applies to unemployed applicants (self-dependent disabled counted individually)
source_notes: Income limit is 50000/yr rural, 100000/yr urban for unemployed applicants; interest rate 4-9% depending on loan amount

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
ownership_requirement: Must be a member of a Self-Help Group (SHG)
business_type_allowed: Group and individual rural livelihood/enterprise activities
special_conditions: SHG must be 6+ months old (individual loans need SHG 2+ years old with prior bank loan and timely repayment); must practice 'Panchasutras' (regular meetings, savings, inter-loaning, timely repayment, updated books)
source_notes: Also includes DDU-GKY (skill training for rural youth aged 15-35) as a linked program

special_conditions: No collateral required; applicant must have no criminal record and no loan default history; NRIs not eligible
source_notes: Three sub-categories (Shishu/Kishor/Tarun) based on business stage; women entrepreneurs may get additional interest reduction at lender discretion

target_category: Traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 notified trades)
loan_subsidy_amount: Enterprise Development Loan up to 300000 in two tranches (100000 then 200000)
business_type_allowed: Traditional hand-tool trades (carpentry; blacksmithing; pottery; tailoring; etc. - 18 notified trades)
special_conditions: Must not have availed similar self-employment loans (PMEGP, MUDRA, PM SVANidhi) in past 5 years unless fully repaid; only one member per family eligible; government employees and their families excluded
source_notes: Also includes skill training stipend (Rs 500/day) and toolkit incentive up to Rs 15000; concessional interest rate 5% with 8% government subvention

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry_body: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
loan_subsidy_amount: First loan up to 15000; second up to 25000; third up to 50000 (tranches increase with timely repayment)
special_conditions: Must have been vending on or before 24 March 2020; requires Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body
source_notes: 7% per annum interest subsidy on timely repayment; digital transaction cashback up to Rs 1200/year; lending extended to March 2030

loan_subsidy_amount: 100% cost of approved training project borne by Ministry (skill training, not direct enterprise loan)
business_type_allowed: Traditional and modern trade skill training leading to self-employment or wage employment
special_conditions: Implemented through empanelled Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs); covers both unemployed youth and existing self-employed/wage-earning individuals seeking upskilling
status: Active (verify current guidelines - scheme dates from 2013-14)
source_notes: Skill-development scheme rather than direct loan/subsidy; feeds into self-employment readiness rather than funding a business directly

ministry_body: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
loan_subsidy_amount: Grant up to 2000000 for validation/prototype; up to 5000000 as debt/convertible instrument for scaling
business_type_allowed: Technology-driven innovative and scalable business models (priority sectors: agriculture; healthcare; biotech; water/waste management; education; defence; space; railways; financial inclusion)
special_conditions: Must be DPIIT-recognised; incorporated not more than 2 years before application; turnover must not have exceeded INR 100 crore in any financial year; must not be formed by splitting/reconstructing an existing business; must not have received more than INR 10 lakh under other government schemes
status: Active (application window closed 31 May 2026 per one source - verify current status)
source_notes: Funds disbursed via DPIIT-approved incubators, not directly to startups; structurally very different from individual-applicant schemes - useful as a contrasting test case for your model

scheme_name: PMEGP Loan and Subsidy for Ex-Servicemen Self Help Groups
ministry_body: Ministry of MSME / KVIC (via DGR sponsorship)
ownership_requirement: Must be a Self Help Group with Ex-Servicemen entrepreneur member
loan_subsidy_amount: Term loan plus subsidy (same structure as standard PMEGP)
special_conditions: Units that have already availed government subsidy under any other scheme (PMRY/REGP/PMEGP/CMEGP or state scheme) are not eligible
source_notes: Administered as an extension of PMEGP specifically routed through Self Help Groups with ex-servicemen members

scheme_name: NEDFi Opportunity Scheme for Small Enterprises (NoSSE)
loan_subsidy_amount: Up to 10000000 (for project cost above 5000000 up to 20000000)
business_type_allowed: New industrial units and infrastructure projects; expansion/diversification/modernisation of existing enterprises
special_conditions: Must be located in Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Tripura, or Mizoram; minimum debt-equity ratio of 2:1
source_notes: Interest rate approximately 8% per annum; separate NEDFi Women Enterprise Development Scheme exists for women aged 18-50 with loans up to Rs 15 lakh at 8% interest

ministry_body: Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying
ownership_requirement: Not applicable (individuals, cooperatives, SHGs, JLGs, and firms all eligible)
loan_subsidy_amount: Subsidy 40-60% of project cost depending on beneficiary category
business_type_allowed: Fisheries and aquaculture (fish farming; hatcheries; cold chain; processing; fishing boats; marketing infrastructure)
special_conditions: Special provisions and higher subsidy rates for SC/ST/women/differently-abled beneficiaries and SHGs
source_notes: Beneficiary categories determine subsidy percentage; scheme covers full value chain from production to marketing

ministry_body: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (under MoSJE)
loan_subsidy_amount: Up to 1000000 (young professional scheme); other sub-schemes up to 500000
special_conditions: Must belong to a caste on the OBC list with valid caste certificate; annual family income must not exceed Rs 3 lakh (varies by sub-scheme, some use double-poverty-line threshold); NBCFDC finances 85-95% of project cost
source_notes: Multiple sub-schemes: general term loan, Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (women, up to Rs 1 lakh at 5%), Micro Finance Scheme (up to Rs 50000), education loan (up to Rs 25 lakh)

scheme_name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) - Maharashtra
ministry_body: Government of Maharashtra - Directorate of Industries
education_requirement: 7th standard pass for projects 10-25L; 10th standard pass for projects above 25L
loan_subsidy_amount: Subsidy 15-35% of project cost (Backend Subsidy); balance as bank term loan
business_type_allowed: Manufacturing (up to 50L project cost);Service and agro-based/primary agro processing (up to 20L project cost)
special_conditions: Must be Maharashtra resident (domicile certificate if born elsewhere); age relaxed by 5 years for special category (SC/ST/Women/ExServicemen/Disabled); only one person per family eligible; must complete 10-day Entrepreneurship Development Programme after loan approval; must not have availed subsidy under any other Central/State scheme
source_notes: State-level equivalent of PMEGP; beneficiary contributes 5-10% of project cost depending on category; subsidy held as 3-year Term Deposit

scheme_name: New Entrepreneur cum Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS) - Tamil Nadu
ministry_body: Government of Tamil Nadu - Directorate of Industries and Commerce
education_requirement: Degree;Diploma;ITI or Vocational Training from recognised institution
ownership_requirement: First-generation entrepreneur only (no existing business background in family)
loan_subsidy_amount: Capital subsidy 25% of project cost up to max 7500000; plus 3% interest subvention
business_type_excluded: Business enterprises without capital expenditure;Fully self-financed projects
special_conditions: Must be Tamil Nadu resident for at least 3 years; age cap 35 for general category, 45 for special categories (Women/SC/ST/BC/MBC/Minority/ExServicemen/Disabled/Transgender); project cost must be between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 5 crore; promoter contributes 10% (general) or 5% (special category); must not have availed subsidy under PMRY/REGP/PMEGP/UYEGP or similar schemes before
source_notes: Targets educated first-generation entrepreneurs specifically - degree/diploma requirement makes this structurally distinct from PMEGP-style schemes with minimal education criteria
